title: Let’s Worm
summary: A prompt-driven literary art platform where short fiction and illustration take turns leading the way.
intro: Let’s Worm is an ongoing collaboration with writer Dan Murphy, pairing strange, compact stories with drawings, paintings, and visual experiments made in response.

heroImage.alt: Let’s Worm issue landing page featuring the Moon City title and a large sculptural pink worm

role: Creative direction · Illustration · Design and engineering

designSystem.name: Let's Worm Design System
designSystem.summary: A warm, strange, and accessible editorial system that gives Let's Worm a coherent literary identity while keeping stories resilient across themes, viewports, content lengths, and input methods.

principles.name: Editorial before ornamental
principles.description: Stories, contributors, and issue context remain clear before the system introduces visual flourish.

principles.name: Warm, strange, and human
principles.description: Caslon, Futura, paper tones, mauve, and the worm motif create handmade character without compromising legibility.

principles.name: Movement has meaning
principles.description: Motion communicates state and continuity while reduced-motion users receive an equivalent static experience.

principles.name: Resilient by default
principles.description: Components tolerate long titles, absent images, narrow containers, zoom, and light or dark environments.

principles.name: Native interaction first
principles.description: Links, buttons, forms, headings, and landmarks retain native behavior, visible focus, and clear accessible names.

internalNotes: Pete confirmed ownership of the current site's design and build. Illustration and collaboration credit are also supported by the live site and prior portfolio copy.
